data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that extends ListWheelScrollView to support horizontal scrolling.
data.what_it_does: Adds a scrollDirection parameter to ListWheelScrollView, allowing developers to create horizontal wheel scroll views alongside vertical ones. It respects physics parameters and supports state restoration via restorationId.
use_when: You need a wheel scroll effect that scrolls horizontally.
You want to use ListWheelScrollView with a custom scroll direction.
avoid_when: You only need standard vertical list wheel scrolling.
You require complex 3D game engines or rendering.
strengths: Supports horizontal scrolling layout for wheel lists.
